what: Synthetic lines drawn by real programs (a browser, and a word processor in six fonts), read back with pypdf. 'visual' is the layout-mode text of one page after the ligature map fix, line by line; 'plain' is the plain-mode text of the same page from an untouched reader (used only to repair words split by stray spaces); 'expected' is the reading-order text. 'match' says how strictly a line must agree: 'exact' (equal after collapsing whitespace) or 'letters' (same characters in the same order, whitespace ignored).
